findings.claim: The entire diff consists of a single binary Playwright snapshot image and implements none of the required scope: no GitHub Pages deployment workflow, no quality gating, no configuration, no documentation, and no verification harness is added or modified anywhere in the change.
findings.evidence: The diff contains exactly one hunk: 'new file mode 100644 ... Binary files /dev/null and b/tests/browser/v3-docs-pages.spec.ts-snapshots/homepage-mobile-linux.png differ'. The acceptance criteria require 'Implement the full scope in the v3-docs-github-pages plan section' (Protected, quality-gated GitHub Pages deployment) and 'Add deterministic verification for every acceptance criterion in that section' — no YAML workflow, script, config, or spec file appears in the diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement the actual v3-docs-github-pages vertical slice (deployment workflow, gating, verification scripts) and include those changes in the diff; a snapshot image alone cannot satisfy the plan section.

findings.claim: A Playwright snapshot is committed without the spec file that references it: the file tree contains no tests/browser/v3-docs-pages.spec.ts, so the snapshot is orphaned and any test run that regenerates snapshots will either fail on mismatch or silently treat it as unused.
findings.evidence: The file_tree lists './tests/browser' but no 'v3-docs-pages.spec.ts' anywhere in the repository; Playwright snapshot paths are derived from the spec filename ('v3-docs-pages.spec.ts-snapshots'), which therefore must exist for this artifact to have meaning.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the v3-docs-pages.spec.ts test file (and its CI wiring) in the change, or remove the orphaned snapshot.

findings.claim: Acceptance criterion 'Update examples/coverage.json, public API ledgers, skills, and documentation whenever this change affects their declared surface' and 'Record verification evidence, unresolved platform/manual limits, and release impact before archive' are unmet: the diff touches no coverage file, ledger, release/evidence document, or docs page.
findings.evidence: The diff's only path is a PNG under tests/browser/; the acceptance criteria explicitly enumerate updates to examples/coverage.json, ledgers, documentation, and verification evidence recording, none of which appear.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the required coverage/ledger/evidence updates as part of the change before it can be considered for archive.

findings.claim: The snapshot is a '-linux.png' platform-specific binary; committing only the Linux variant with no visible spec, CI snapshot-update policy, or other-platform strategy risks nondeterministic CI failures on macOS/Windows runners and masks the 'unresolved platform/manual limits' the criteria require to be recorded.
findings.evidence: Filename 'homepage-mobile-linux.png' is Playwright's platform-suffixed snapshot convention; the diff provides no accompanying configuration (e.g., snapshotPathTemplate, CI update-snapshots step) and the criteria demand recording of platform limits, which is absent.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the snapshot platform policy (Linux-only CI runs or explicit update-snapshots workflow) alongside the test that consumes this artifact.
